ops.loadingHours: The loading and unloading routes and dimensions are given in the official load-in/load-out route map. International Convention Center Pamir: loading elevator 2.6 m wide x 6.7 m deep x 2.2 m high, load capacity 5,400 kg. Hiten: loading door 3.6 m wide x 3.5 m high. Banquet building of Shin Takanawa: loading elevator door 1.5 m wide x 2.2 m high; inside the car 1.9 m wide x 2.5 m deep x 2.5 m high, load capacity 2,500 kg. (Banquet Hall Brochure, April 2024 edition)
ops.parking: The parking facilities of the two Takanawa area hotels together hold 1,000 cars. B1 to B3 of International Convention Center Pamir have space for 600 cars (Brochure, April 2024 edition). The regular rate is 600 yen per 30 minutes (revised July 5, 2025). For banquet use, parking is free for up to 4 hours; beyond that, parking fees apply according to time.
ops.waitingRooms: The small banquet rooms Fuji (26㎡) and Hagi (30㎡) on Shin Takanawa 3F can be used as waiting rooms. At International Convention Center Pamir, the 4 small rooms on 1F (Ogyoku, Seigyoku, Kogyoku and Hakugyoku, 119㎡ each) are suited to waiting rooms and event offices. Aoba, Matsuba, Wakakusa, Wakashiba and Wakaba on 2F can be used as breakout rooms or waiting rooms. The Meeting Room (57㎡) on Shin Takanawa 1F is suited to an event office or VIP waiting room. Changing rooms are on the 2F of the Annex of Grand Prince Hotel Takanawa and on the 2F of International Convention Center Pamir.
ops.restaurants: Inside Grand Prince Hotel Shin Takanawa are Slope Side Diner Zakuro Buffet & Cafe (B1), Shimizu Japanese Restaurant, Shumei Japanese-style Room, Kokiden Chinese Restaurant, Momiji Lounge and Asama Main Bar. Zakuro, Shimizu, Kokiden and Shumei have private rooms, for which a room charge is separate. The hotel's suggested uses include a networking party in Hiten after a meeting, or dinner at one of the hotel's restaurants.
